<C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0001,><C:0001,0004,>- Here Lies a Hero of Buffness -
Muscle Lord Longbathes<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>The opening of the Great Sauna would never
have come to pass without Longbathes.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>None could match his knowledge of the bathing
arts, and he was rightfully revered for it.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Claiming the temperature needed to match that
of hot magma, he pioneered scalding therapy.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>No one could approach his love for soaking,
and so he soaks here, eternal and pruney.<C:0003,0001,>
